title: Try Sr, ANOTHER ROUND
author: Active_Method6575
selftext:
I was finally able to create a game that I’d had in mind for a long time. I love \*Balatro\* and its simplicity, but I was also fascinated by the aesthetic of \*Cloverpit\*; thanks to the many AI tools available now, I was able to build it entirely with their help. These tools were instrumental in refining what I had already created, as well as handling translations and various other tasks. I hope you’ll give it a try—I’ll leave some keys below.

[https://wesly00.itch.io/sr-another-round](https://wesly00.itch.io/sr-another-round)

**I’d be happy to hear your thoughts; I’m still in the process of improving.**

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jiMt\_dhuq1o&t=1s](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jiMt_dhuq1o&t=1s)
